gloss: shuttered shopping street; street of closed-up shops

definitions.gloss: shuttered shopping street; street of closed-up shops
definitions.explanation: A shopping street where many shops have closed and rolled their shutters down for good, leaving the arcade half-empty — a symbol of decline in local retail districts.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}がシャッター{通|どお}りになった。
examples.english: The area in front of the station has become a shuttered shopping street.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{商店街|しょうてんがい}はシャッター{通|どお}りが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Shuttered shopping streets are increasing in regional commercial districts.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}はにぎやかだった{商店街|しょうてんがい}も、{今|いま}ではすっかりシャッター{通|どお}りだ。
examples.english: The shopping street that was once lively is now completely shuttered.

notes:
From シャッター (shop shutter) + {通|どお}り (street). A shopping arcade where so many businesses have closed that the shutters stay down along the street. Often cited as a sign of rural depopulation and competition from large suburban stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シャッター{通|どお}りになる: to turn into a shuttered street
- シャッター{街|がい}: shuttered district (synonym)

RELATED:
- {商店街|しょうてんがい}: shopping street/arcade — the kind of district that becomes a シャッター{通|どお}り
